This is a bizarre and slightly surrealist romantic comedy, set in an idyllic-looking, yet haunting European setting, with modernist apartment blocks, office buildings and red-roofed historical houses, which are busting with people, each of whom feels superficially content yet slightly dead inside. Celestine Weeks is a beautiful, elegant, self-assured and serenely calm young woman. She lives is a city that is absolutely plagued by traffic accident. Despite (or because?) their frequency, people do not seem to mind them, continuing with their lives as if everything was fine. Celestine feels that something is wrong with this city, but keeps quiet, not wanting to attract problematic attention to herself. After difficult and laborious treatment and rehabilitation in hospital, Celestine is left a wheelchair-bound paraplegic.
